title: The Cat at the Bottom of the Lake

verse 1.lyrics: Black lake past the school, the grown-ups say don't go, I hear it hum-ming low, ev-ery night. Soft as sleep-ing rain, say-ing my name once, I laced my shoes and went, no-bod-y knew.

chorus.lyrics: The cat at the bot-tom of the lake, she purrs in her sleep, stay with me. The cat at the bot-tom of the lake, Mur-mur is her breath, I can't leave.

verse 2.lyrics: Wa-ter at my knees, then my throat, then gone, I did-n't need to breathe, down be-low. Two moons o-pen wide, gold-en, slow, a-live, curled round a drowned church bell, Cath-ul-hu.

bridge.lyrics: purr we are her dream purr don't let her wake

verse 3.lyrics: Dawn, and I'm on shore, shoes full of cold sand, ev-ery-one's still a-sleep, or are they. Now the whole town hums, low and ver-y sweet, if you hear it, don't tell, she's dream-ing.

notes: I don't have a full lore file in front of me, so this is my own telling: the Murmur is the lake's hum, which is really Cathulhu purring in her sleep. She's curled around a drowned church bell, and the whole town only exists because she's dreaming it. The purr in the bridge and outro is whispered and (Nyx on synth) (Wick: hum & lights)
idea: Record this: A lore single that tells the Cathulhu and Murmur story as a song (stay true to everything Nyx knows of Cathulhu's lore and the Murmur so far), story-driven verses, a haunting chorus, Cathulhu's purr. This one will get a music video like a short anime episode.
lyrics:
[verse 1]
Black lake past the school, the grownups say don't go, I hear it humming low, every night. Soft as sleeping rain, saying my name once, I laced my shoes and went, nobody knew.

[chorus]
The cat at the bottom of the lake, she purrs in her sleep, stay with me. The cat at the bottom of the lake, Murmur is her breath, I can't leave.

[verse 2]
Water at my knees, then my throat, then gone, I didn't need to breathe, down below. Two moons open wide, golden, slow, alive, curled round a drowned church bell, Cathulhu.

[bridge]
purr we are her dream purr don't let her wake

[verse 3]
Dawn, and I'm on shore, shoes full of cold sand, everyone's still asleep, or are they. Now the whole town hums, low and very sweet, if you hear it, don't tell, she's dreaming.
